title: CSB Bancorp, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: CSB Bancorp, Inc., a small Ohio-based regional bank holding company, filed an 8-K reporting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders on April 22, 2026. Shareholders elected two directors to three-year terms and ratified the appointment of S.R. Snodgrass, P.C. as the company's independent auditor for fiscal year 2026.
key_points: CSB Bancorp held its 2026 Annual Meeting on April 22, 2026
2,627,015 common shares outstanding as of the March 3, 2026 record date
1,891,816 shares (72%) were represented at the meeting
Robert K. Baker and Vikki G. Briggs elected as directors for terms expiring in 2029
S.R. Snodgrass, P.C. ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026
Voting results: 1,889,476 for, 842 against, 1,498 abstain on auditor ratification
